description: This file implements HTTP Range request handling according to RFC 7233, including parsing range headers, coalescing overlapping ranges, and generating partial content responses for server requests.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int http_range_coalesce_unsorted(off_t * const restrict ranges,int n)
methods.description: Coalesces overlapping or near-overlapping HTTP byte ranges in an unsorted list.

methods.name: const char * http_range_parse_next(const char * restrict s,const off_t len,off_t * const restrict ranges)
methods.description: Parses the next byte range segment from the Range header string.

methods.name: int http_range_parse(const char * restrict s,const off_t content_length,off_t ranges[RMAX * 2])
methods.description: Parses entire Range header value into individual byte ranges.

methods.name: void http_range_single(request_st * const r,const off_t ranges[2])
methods.description: Handles a single range request, modifying the request's write queue accordingly.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_range_multi(request_st * const r,const off_t ranges[RMAX * 2],const int n)
methods.description: Handles multiple ranges by generating multipart responses.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int http_range_not_satisfiable(request_st * const r,const off_t content_length)
methods.description: Handles the case where requested ranges are invalid or unsatisfiable, setting 416 status.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int http_range_process(request_st * const r,const buffer * const http_range)
methods.description: Main processing function for Range requests, deciding between single, multipart, or rejection.

methods.name: int http_range_rfc7233(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Entry point for processing Range headers according to RFC 7233, invoked during request handling.

ctags.name: http_range_multi
ctags.signature: (request_st * const r,const off_t ranges[RMAX * 2],const int n)

ctags.pattern: /^http_range_parse (const char * restrict s, const off_t content_length,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * restrict s,const off_t content_length,off_t ranges[RMAX * 2])

ctags.name: http_range_parse_next
ctags.pattern: /^http_range_parse_next (const char * restrict s, const off_t len,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * restrict s,const off_t len,off_t * const restrict ranges)

ctags.pattern: /^http_range_process (request_st * const r, const buffer * const http_range)$/
